# commit demo (test)

A module with one machine `cmach` (three params: one latched, one with a click action) and one effect `cfx` (one page, one param), declared by builder calls in `init`. The DSP routines do nothing. It is the fixture of `modules/core/runtime/tests/capacity/commit.device.test.ts`: the committed rows, the voice row ranges and latch mask, the effect page, and the refusals at commit.
